name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 26, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Julia Hemenez, Member of the Community
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
There are no presentations scheduled on this agenda.*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-22, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 30 Miles Per Hour on North Avenue / North Drive between N. Melrose Drive and W. Los Angeles Drive";
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-23, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 25 Miles Per Hour on W. Los Angeles Drive between North Drive and N. Santa Fe Avenue"; and
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-24, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 25 Miles Per Hour on Townsite Drive between N. Santa Fe Avenue and E. Vista Way."
C5.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending June 30, 2008 (CC)
C6.
Amendment of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) and Cabaret Licenses for San Giorgio Lucano, 1280 E. Vista Way, Suites 1-3 (CC)
C7.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, amending the lists of designated employees in both Conflict of Interest Codes; and rescinding resolutions in conflict thereof:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ;
b.
Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2008- ; and
2.
Direct the City/District Manager to sign, and the City Clerk to file, the 2008 Local Agency Biennial Notices for the City of Vista and the Buena Sanitation District prior to August 31, 2008.
C8.
Rent Waiver for Chamber of Commerce at 201 Washington Street (CC)
C9.
Americans with Disabilities Act Transition Plan - Amendment to Agreement (CC)
C10.
Park and Recreation Facility Rental Fees (CC)
C11.
Wave Waterpark - Slide Tower Pump Replacement (CC)
C12.
Vista Village Drive/W. Vista Way Intersection Repair Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , awarding a contract with International Pavement Solutions for construction of the Vista Village Drive/W. Vista Way Intersection Repair project; and
2.
Authorize the City Manager to approve amendments to the contract up to twenty-five percent of the original amount.
C13.
National Competition Travel Assistance Policy (CC)
C14.
Adjustment of the Vista Fire Protection District Fee for Services (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Loan Agreement for 347 West Los Angeles Street Project (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Loan Agreement between the Commission and San Diego County Supportive Housing, Inc., for the development of a 15-unit affordable housing project at 347 West Los Angeles Drive; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Loan Agreement between the Commission and San Diego Supportive Housing, Inc., making a finding of benefit, and authorizing the use of low and moderate income housing funds outside of the Vista Redevelopment Project Area.
D2.
Designation of Voting Delegates for League of California Cities (LOCC) Annual Conference and Consideration of Proposed League Resolutions (CC)
1.
Designate one person to serve as the City's primary voting delegate and two others to serve as alternates; and
2.
Adopt positions of support on the four resolutions slated for the LOCC Annual Conference.
D3.
Economic Stimulus Package (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving City Council Policy No. 500-1, the Vista Economic Stimulus Package; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Charted City of Vista, California, Amending Section 17.60.090 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to the Collection of Development Impact Fees."
D4.
Wayfinding Program Design Concepts (CC)
D5.
Mid-Term Review of Five-Year Capital Improvement Plan & Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, amending the FY 2008-2009 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budgets:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ; and
b.
Community Development Resolution No.
2008- ; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , approving the CIP Budget for FY 2008-2009.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Amendment No. 4 to the Vista Redevelopment Plan (CC/CDC)
1.
Open the public hearing on the proposed Amendment No. 4 and the Certification of a Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR);
2.
Continue the public hearing to the regular City Council/Community Development Commission meeting of September 23, 2008, at which time public testimony will be received; and
3.
Defer consideration of the following resolutions and ordinance until immediately following the completion of the public hearing process:
a.
Community Development Commission (CDC) Resolution No. 2008- , approving and transmitting its report from the Commission to the City Council;
b.
CDC Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR) for Vista Redevelopment Plan Amendment No. 4;
c.
CDC Resolution No. 2008- , finding that the Provision of Low and Moderate Income Housing Outside the Boundaries of the Proposed Amendment Area will be of benefit to the project;
d.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final EIR for Vista Redevelopment Plan Amendment No. 4;
e.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , finding the Provision of Low and Moderate Income Housing Outside the Boundaries of the Proposed Amendment Area will be of benefit to the project; and
f.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, adopting the Redevelopment Plan Amendment No. 4 for the Vista Redevelopment Project."
PH2.
La Tortuga Drive Traffic Signal Reimbursement Agreement (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a reimbursement agreement with Vista Imperial, LLC; and
2.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the documents in the County Recorder's Office.
PH3.
Habitat for Humanity Project (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an Acquisition and Conveyance Agreement for the donation and conveyance of property to the Community Development Commission (CDC);
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the DDA and associated documents with San Diego Habitat for Humanity, Inc., for the development of the Habitat for Humanity Project;
3.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the escrow instructions, deeds and other documents and actions required to close escrow and implement the project on behalf of the City;
4.
Adopt CDC Resolution No. 2008- , approving an Acquisition and Conveyance Agreement and the receipt of property from the City of Vista;
5.
Adopt CDC Resolution No. 2008- , approving a DDA and associated documents with San Diego Habitat for Humanity, Inc., for the development of the Habitat for Humanity Project; and
6.
Authorize the Executive Director to execute the Regulatory Agreement, escrow instructions, deeds and all other documents and actions required to close escrow and implement the project on behalf of the City and the CDC.
PH4.
Appeal of Melrose Square Retail Center and Hotel, TMACK Melrose LLC, applicant (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Subsequent Mitigated Negative Declaration under CEQA for the Melrose Square Retail Center and Hotel project at the northwest corner of S. Melrose Drive and Sycamore Avenue; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , granting a Special Use Permit, inclusive of a Site Development Plan, for 20,472 square feet of commercial retail space in three buildings including a drive through financial institution or coffee facility, and a 93-room hotel, and approving a Tentative Parcel Map at the northwest corner of S. Melrose Drive and Sycamore Avenue.
PH5.
Zoning Code Amendment for Large Family Day Care Homes (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Development Code; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Charted City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Large Family Day Care Homes."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
